dataset_name: Bihar Flood Management Information System (FMIS) Inundation Layers
license: Water Resources Department (WRD), Government of Bihar / FMISC Public Domain Notice (View/Advisory access; raw vector/raster layers distributed via inter-agency GIS protocols)
spatial_resolution: Nominal 30m-50m (derived from NRSC RADARSAT processed 1-bit raster inundation layers)
geographic_coverage: State of Bihar, India (38 districts; North and South Bihar river basins)

label_definition.1: Observed flood water spread / inundation extent

known_limitations: Public web services serve cartographic JPEG rendering sheets rather than direct OGC WFS/GeoTIFF raster download endpoints.
Raw satellite ingestion requires state agency clearance or georeferencing of bulletin extent layers.
Represents 2D inundation footprint without water column depth or hydrodynamic velocity.
